result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts`. I haven't run or tested it.

- `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`.
- `createDownloadLink` sets `expiresAt` to 7 days from now, as an ISO timestamp.
- The URL now looks like `?token=…&expires=<expiresAt>`, with the timestamp URL-encoded.

This only puts the expiry in the link and the returned object. Nothing here rejects an expired link, so the download side has to check `expires` itself. I didn't look for other code that builds `DownloadLink` objects, which would now need `expiresAt` too.
